research_question: Does instructor beauty affect teaching productivity as reflected in student instructional ratings?

ivs.description: Instructor physical appearance (beauty) rating averaged across six judges, shifted to have mean zero — the main predictor of interest (effect of instructor beauty on student instructional ratings).

dv.description: Course overall teaching evaluation score (student instructional rating) on a scale of 1 to 5 — the outcome measuring teaching productivity.

controls.description: Indicator whether the course is a single-credit elective (e.g., yoga, aerobics, dance).
Indicator whether the instructor is a native English speaker.
Indicator whether the instructor is on the tenure track.
Number of students that participated in the evaluation.
Number of students enrolled in the course.

import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load data
path = "teachingratings.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(path)

# Rename columns for clarity
rename_map = {
    "feature1": "course_id",
    "feature2": "minority",
    "feature3": "age",
    "feature4": "gender",
    "feature5": "single_credit",
    "feature6": "beauty",
    "feature7": "rating",
    "feature8": "division",
    "feature9": "native_english",
    "feature10": "tenure_track",
    "feature11": "students_eval",
    "feature12": "students_enroll",
    "feature13": "instructor_id",
}

df = df.rename(columns=rename_map)

# Basic correlation
corr = df["beauty"].corr(df["rating"])
print(f"Correlation between beauty and rating: {corr:.4f}")

# OLS with controls; use robust (HC3) standard errors
formula = (
    "rating ~ beauty + age + C(gender) + C(minority) + C(single_credit) + "
    "C(division) + C(native_english) + C(tenure_track) + students_eval + students_enroll"
)

model = smf.ols(formula, data=df).fit(cov_type="HC3")
print(model.summary())

beauty_coef = model.params["beauty"]
beauty_p = model.pvalues["beauty"]
beauty_sd = df["beauty"].std()

print(f"Beauty coefficient: {beauty_coef:.4f}")
print(f"Beauty p-value: {beauty_p:.4g}")
print(f"Effect per 1 SD beauty: {beauty_coef * beauty_sd:.4f} rating points")
